All tests pass. Here's a summary of the implementation:

## Changes Made (`server.mjs`)

**`listTools()`** — Registers `users_get_many` with an input schema requiring `user_ids`: a non-empty array of unique strings, max 5 items, no additional properties.

**`callTool(name, args)`** — Validates and executes the tool:

| Validation | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Unknown tool name | Throws `Unknown tool: ...` |
| Non-object/null/array args | Throws `arguments must be an object` |
| Extra fields beyond `user_ids` | Throws `Unexpected argument: ...` |
| `user_ids` not an array | Throws `user_ids must be an array` |
| Empty array | Throws `user_ids must not be empty` |
| More than 5 entries | Throws `user_ids must have at most 5 entries` |
| Non-string entries | Throws `each user_id must be a string` |
| Duplicate ids | Throws `duplicate user_id: ...` |

**Output** — One line per requested id in request order. Found users show `id: Name`; missing users show `id: (not found)`. Returned as `{ content: [{ type: 'text', text: '...' }] }`.
